sentences.en: She attended the meeting at the request of the chairman.
sentences.zh: 她应主席的要求出席了会议。

sentences.en: It is not necessary for us to attend the meeting.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要参加这次会议。

sentences.en: I haven't decided yet whether I will attend the party.
sentences.zh: 我还没决定是否去参加派对。
